name: Little Vampire
source: "Little Vampire" is one of the first games by Alice Soft, still under their former label of Champion Soft. Main heroes are the returning characters of the Rance series - Miki and Kentarou. In this game Miki is kidnapped by Dracula and Kentarou is on the quest to save her.
translation: "Little Vampire" is one of the first games by Alice Soft, still under their former label of Champion Soft. Main heroes are the returning characters of the Rance series - Miki and Kentarou. In this game Miki is kidnapped by Dracula and Kentarou is on the quest to save her.
